name: Lantern Knight
description: A keyblade-bearing pioneer. Travel to charge a lantern pulse; build a bustling brigade.

name: Postmaster
description: A wandering parcel launcher. Collected gold charges automatic express volleys.

name: Drowsy Seer
description: A sleepy tuning-bell oracle. Stand still to chill nearby threats and erase a few hostile bullets.

name: The Root Oracle
description: Stationary in combat. Whole-arena pickup and a slowing ward. Walks in shops.

name: The Lone Jelly
description: Travels without roster companions; absorbs purchased companions' traits. Strong attacks and natural recovery support relic-focused builds.

name: Lady Loaded Dice
description: Collect 6 gold to burst nearby enemies. High luck and critical chance; low health.

name: The Tide Singer
description: Collect 8 gold to heal 3 health and push nearby enemies back.

name: The Comet Courier
description: Travel 10 units to release a slowing pulse. Moving charges it; shops do not.

name: The Mirror Keeper
description: Stand still for 2 seconds to reflect up to 3 nearby bullets. Moving resets charge.

name: The Treasure Clerk
description: Every 10 collected gold grants 1 extra gold and a small healing pulse.

name: Verdant Matron
description: Nursery shops sell Little Sprouts. Buying a Sprout adds 1 projectile (max 6) and costs 2 maximum HP. Two Sprouts grow into a random evolved friend plus a Grand Sprout.

name: Copper Cauldron
description: Start with +8 contact damage. Each Morning Bells activation gives +0.15 armor. Taking damage adds 0.15 regeneration for this run. Enemies move 10% faster.

name: China Marionette
description: Healing is 2.5 times as effective, but armor starts 0.25 lower. Each Wild Stitch activation adds 0.4 regeneration. Taking damage adds 1 contact damage.

name: Soap Skater
description: Ordinary attacks deal 35% less damage. Push ordinary enemies harder, within the push cap. Each Clockwork Union activation adds 4 wave income. Treasure +20%.

name: Velvet Regent
description: You do not attack. Your personal damage, attack speed, critical chance and projectile bonuses also help allies. Shops may sell evolved companions. More enemies appear.

name: Button Cavalier
description: Start with 35% dodge and 35% less HP. Dodge cap: 75%. Dodges add treasure detection for this run. Toy Knights deal 30% more damage.

name: Night Maw
description: Lose 1 HP each second in battle. Each enemy defeated heals 1 HP. Regeneration and hearts do not heal. Every fourth wave raises everyone's movement speed.

name: Thorn Treasurer
description: Dream shops follow the shared 3-4-wave schedule. At wave start, maximum HP follows saved gold (20–400). Buying a spiked relic recruits a Bristle Ball. Team damage -20%.

name: Citrus Marshal
description: You do not attack. Move 20% faster and gain 50% HP. Allies stay close; contact damage scales with your movement speed. Team attack speed -25%.

name: Ivory Sovereign
description: Start each wave with 18 royal health. Each injury consumes exactly 1 royal health and releases a short retaliation. Ordinary healing cannot refill it. Velvet Court allies gain a projectile.

name: Petal Citadel
description: Start each wave with a balanced blessing: +2 flat melee and ranged damage, +10 HP, +5% speed and +0.15 armor.

name: Patchwork Host
description: All ordinary companion themes may appear. Enemy health +12% and count +6% through wave 8, rising to +35% / +20% at wave 20. Rerolls cost 1 less gold.

name: Archive Curator
description: Shops offer memory companions. Buying one absorbs its support trait instead of adding a body; your last two memories fight beside you as paper exhibits. Each memory makes enemies 2% tougher (max 12%). Your positive personal modifiers are 25% stronger.

name: Penny Broker
description: Relics cost 20% less. Rerolls cost 2 more gold. Each paid refresh adds 1 income and 1% luck for this run.

name: Storm Fencer
description: You do not attack normally. Your contact damage is doubled. Dodging triggers a short forward lightning barrage. Start with +20% dodge.

name: Tin Virtuoso
description: Your shots cannot split. Allies fire only in response to your critical attacks, with their own weapon damage and a short cooldown. Start with +10% critical chance and 2 projectiles.

name: Moon Prowler
description: Move 20% faster. Every 3 seconds spent moving in combat grants 2 gold. Each ally reduces wave income by 1.

name: Supper Mortar
description: Fire up to two delayed mortar shells. Shells cannot pierce. Start with +0.4 armor and +15% movement speed. Enemies move 20% faster.

name: Lantern Weaver
description: Every fourth attack stitches three nearby enemies with a delayed lantern thread. The thread shares one damage budget.

name: Hourglass Stag
description: Every 6 seconds, briefly slow nearby ordinary enemies and release an expanding clock ring. Bosses keep moving.

name: Rain Archivist
description: Each opened chest heals 4 HP and records a raindrop. Every third record releases a fan of frost shots.

name: Kite Admiral
description: A mouse admiral whose kites fly over the brigade's archers.

name: Sundae Duchess
description: A porcelain duchess crowned in ice cream; what she freezes pays.

name: Bonsai Clocksmith
description: A tortoise clocksmith whose bonsai garden keeps time.

name: Juggling Jester
description: A felt jester who keeps five balls in the air.

name: Bell Diver
description: A frog diver who probes the deep and rides a brass bell.
